question: HR-328 (docs/ROSTER.md § Readings): HR-10 says a review finding that cites a ruling id cannot be argued away: the author must fix it or file an amendment. Does that also hold when the cited HR row is only a 'reading' or a reversed/superseded row?

options.label: Any HR row (Recommended)
options.consequence: Confirm the reading: a finding citing any HR row, whatever its status, must be fixed or amended, never pushed back

options.label: Ruled rows only
options.consequence: Amend: only a row whose status is 'ruled' forces fix-or-amend; a finding citing a reading can be pushed back with a reason
